facts.business: Galaxy Surfactants Limited manufactures surfactants and specialty care products for the personal and home care industry.
key_risks: Geopolitical risks and supply-chain fragilities in AMET region
Persistently high fatty alcohol prices impacting performance segment
Reciprocal tariff measures by the United States affecting export-oriented sectors
Local competitive intensity in AMET region
Estimation uncertainty in fair valuation of financial instruments (investment in preference shares of subsidiary)
